stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Why won't my bench sheet build?
stations.note: He wrote it from a book.

stations.title: Compiler
stations.text: Prints half a page of errors and no program.

captions: Kasimir wrote his own bench sheet from a book, and wants to know why it will not build.
The compiler answers with half a page of errors, and no program comes out.
You read each message, find the mistake it points at and fix only that, in four tasks.
Now the bench sheet builds, and prints the springs, the hands, the crystal and the oil.
Same lines Kasimir meant, one fix each. The messages told you where to look.
